gripOrHq.title: Security Code WORM Chip
gripOrHq.rulesText: Play only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn. Trash a piece of unrezzed ice.

gripOrHq.title: Core Command: Jettison Ice
gripOrHq.rulesText: Play only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn. Pay the rez cost of a piece of rezzed ice to trash it.

gripOrHq.title: Restrictive Net Zoning
gripOrHq.rulesText: Choose a data fort when Restrictive Net Zoning is installed. The Corp must pay [2], in addition to the normal cost, to install ice on that fort.

gripOrHq.title: Junkyard BBS
gripOrHq.rulesText: A, [1]: Bring the top card from your trash into your hand.

heapOrArchives.title: Mantis, Fixer-at-Large
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Search your stack for a card, and bring it into your hand. Reshuffle your stack afterwards.

heapOrArchives.title: Krash
heapOrArchives.rulesText:
2 credits: Break ice subroutine.
2 credits: +1 strength.

heapOrArchives.title: Short-Term Contract
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Put [12] from the bank on Short-Term Contract when it is installed. When all the bits have been removed, trash Short-Term Contract. A: Take [2] from Short-Term Contract.

heapOrArchives.title: Mantis, Fixer-at-Large
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Search your stack for a card, and bring it into your hand. Reshuffle your stack afterwards.

scoreArea.title: Netwatch Operations Office
scoreArea.rulesText: A: Trace 2 - If trace is successful, give Runner a tag.

scoreArea.title: Corporate Coup
scoreArea.rulesText:
Put [15] from the bank on Corporate Coup when you score it.
A: Take [3] from Corporate Coup, if it has any bits.

rig.title: Restrictive Net Zoning
rig.rulesText: Choose a data fort when Restrictive Net Zoning is installed. The Corp must pay [2], in addition to the normal cost, to install ice on that fort.

rig.title: Wilson, Weeflerunner Apprentice
rig.rulesText:
Each of your turns, you may choose to gain an action, which you may use only to make a run. You cannot spend more than [3] during that run to pay for using icebreakers or increasing your link. Use this ability only once per turn and only during your turn.
[T]: Avoid receiving a tag.
[T]: Prevent any amount of meat damage.

rig.title: Junkyard BBS
rig.rulesText: A, [1]: Bring the top card from your trash into your hand.

ice.title: Triggerman
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Trash a program.
[Subroutine] End the run.

root.title: Experimental AI
root.rulesText: You may advance Experimental AI before and after you rez it. When Runner accesses Experimental AI, trash one program for each advancement counter on it.

root.title: City Surveillance
root.rulesText: For each card Runner draws, give Runner a tag unless Runner pays [1], in addition to any other costs, to avoid receiving that tag. You may rez City Surveillance just before the card is drawn.
